body_lead: VIJAYAWADA : Andhra Pradesh State police will use the advanced technology such as drones and artificial intelligence to control the organisers from conducting banned rooster fights and other illegal activities in the name of Sankranthi festivities. Director general of police (DGP) Ch Dwaraka Tirumala Rao held a video conference meeting with all the district superintendent of police (SPs) and inspector general of police (IG) rank officers and instructed them to intensify the checkings to ensure the festival of harvest Sankranti celebrated with fervor.
